questions: After revealing Zeus's abduction of a nymph to a river god and later cheating death itself, this mythical king of Corinth was condemned to forever push a boulder up a hill, only to watch it roll back down — who is he?
Sisyphus: King of Ephyra in Greek mythology.
Runner-up on 2017's The Coming One, this Chinese-American musician released his debut single 'I Am Awake' the following year and later joined the Detective Chinatown franchise — who is he?
Victor Ma (simplified; traditional; pinyin: M Bqin; born March 20, 1996) is a Chinese-American singer, songwriter, rapper, and actor.
American male actors of Chinese descent
In what year was VietJet Air founded?
VietJet Air: Low-cost airline from Vietnam.
Which of these four was founded earliest?
Hamburger SV (founded 1887) is the earliest of the four. The outstanding players of this period were Horst Hrubesch, Manfred Kaltz, and Felix Magath, all regulars in the West German national team.
In this 1980 slasher film, teenage camp counselors are murdered one by one while trying to reopen an abandoned summer camp with a tragic past — an early role for a young Kevin Bacon. Name the film?
Friday the 13th (1980 film) is a 1980 American slasher film produced and directed by Sean S. Cunningham.
Which of these four began earliest?

Blending geodesy, trigonometry, and law, this profession uses tools like theodolites, GNSS receivers, and lidar scanners to fix the exact positions of points on Earth for maps and property boundaries — what is it?
Surveying: Science of determining the positions of points and the distances and angles between them.
